about: What a value can be, whatever JSON it goes into. A field of the fields file names one of these as its entity. `lookup` says what stands behind an entity to hold a value against: the list of the parliaments (bodies), a list of the vocabulary (named in `list`), or the register of persons. A new entity is a new entry here, with a list behind it or without; `text` takes what is none of the others.

entities.name: body
entities.means: the polity or the parliament a document belongs to

entities.name: identifier
entities.means: a number or key that names an affair

entities.name: category
entities.means: a kind with a standard name, as the type of an affair

entities.name: group
entities.means: a party, a parliamentary group, a committee, a department

entities.name: place
entities.means: a place something was done at

entities.name: event
entities.means: something that happened to the affair, as a sitting or a decision

entities.name: text
entities.means: wording of the document: a title, a summary, a keyword
